details: US forces reportedly struck Iranian military targets in southern Iran and the Strait of Hormuz on May 4-5, 2026, following drone, cruise missile, and boat attacks by Tehran against US Navy ships and commercial vessels. This escalation, despite being characterized as defensive, sent shockwaves through global markets, including cryptocurrencies. Bitcoin briefly dipped below $80,000, and approximately $300 million in crypto futures were liquidated as traders reacted to the increased risk and uncertainty. The price saw a rebound as signs of possible de-escalation emerged. Iran has also been increasingly using digital assets to circumvent sanctions.
title: US Military Strikes in Strait of Hormuz Rattle Crypto Markets
